subtitle: Creative Stereo Delay
tagline: A stereo feedback instrument where every repeat can evolve: echo, multitap, ping-pong, and tuned comb timing, driven through tape, BBD, or digital character, diffusion, frequency shifting, and grains.

body.lead: TB Delay is a creative stereo delay in which every repeat can change. Start with a clean echo, a dual delay, ping-pong, tuned timing, or tight comb textures, then drive the feedback through tape, BBD, or digital character, modulation, diffusion, frequency shifting, and granular motion.

body.p: Taps, swing, bandwidth, drive, wear, stereo movement, and ducking are shaped in one system, and built-in safeguards keep high feedback musical and controlled. COLOR and SPACE macros move many settings at once, so you can turn a preset darker or more spacious with one control.

ul: TIME MODE: Free (10 ms to 8 s), Sync (1/32 to 1/1 with triplets and dotted values), or Tune (tuned comb)
1, 2, 4, or 8 taps with SPACING and SWING
Single, Dual, Ping Pong, and Ratio stereo styles
Clean, Tape, BBD, and Digital character with drive, wear, filters, modulation, and blur
Transform stage: frequency shift, grain layer, pitch, reverse, density, and spray, applied per repeat (BUILD) or once (ONCE)
FREEZE holds the current tail; DUCK keeps the dry signal clear
99 factory presets in 10 banks, plus Init and user presets

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB Delay 1.0.3 for Windows (VST3). The current macOS build is also version 1.0.3; small differences between platforms are possible.

ol: Insert TB Delay on a vocal, guitar, synth, or send. The defaults are Sync at 1/8, Ping Pong, `FEEDBACK` 48%, `MIX` 30%, `WIDTH` 130%, and `DUCK` 25%.
Choose `TIME MODE`: Free for milliseconds, Sync to follow the host tempo, or Tune for tuned comb effects.
Set `DELAY TIME`, then raise `FEEDBACK` for more repeats.
Choose `TYPE` (Clean, Tape, BBD, Digital) and shape the repeats with `LOW CUT` and `HIGH CUT`.
Set `MIX` and `DUCK` so the repeats support the source instead of covering it.
Try the COLOR and SPACE macros to push a preset darker, cleaner, tighter, or wider.

STEREO bypass sets topology, offset, and width to neutral; CHARACTER / SPACE bypass skips character, filters, modulation, and diffusion; TRANSFORM bypass skips the grain and frequency transform.

tip.text: The macros move several parameters together, so the individual knobs change while you turn them. Use them to explore, then fine-tune the knobs.

body.p: Step through presets with the arrows, or open the PRESETS list to choose a factory or user preset. Save asks for a name and stores a .tbdelay file in the User folder. The name shows Custom after you change a setting. Undo and Redo step through recent changes.

The 99 factory presets are grouped in 10 banks: Essential Echo, Grain & Freeze, Slap & Double, Rhythm & Multitap, Ping Pong & Stereo, Tape & Analog, Digital & Lo-Fi, Comb & Resonance, Spiral & Shift, and Space & Diffusion. Examples include **Clean Utility**, **Dub Throw**, **Studio Slap 80**, **Dotted Pulse Train**, **Warm Reel Echo**, **12-Bit Repeat**, **Plucked Wire**, **Gentle Lift**, **Grain Cloud**, and **Wide Ambient Wash**.
Starting points for common jobs. Adjust them by ear.

recipes.title: Vocal throw
recipes.use: Repeats that answer the vocal without covering it.
steps: Lower HIGH CUT to about 5 to 7 kHz so the repeats sit behind the voice.

recipes.title: Slapback
recipes.use: A short, single repeat for vocals or guitar.
steps: Use Free mode and set DELAY TIME between 80 and 140 ms.

recipes.title: Tape echo
steps: Lower HIGH CUT as WEAR rises to keep the repeats dark.

recipes.title: Spiral shimmer
steps: Negative FREQ SHIFT makes the spiral fall instead.

rows: FEEDBACK is above 100%. Lower it, or use FREEZE deliberately when you want a held tail.
Raise DUCK, lower MIX, or lower HIGH CUT and raise LOW CUT.
Changing DELAY TIME makes pitch swoops.
TIME CHANGE is on Glide. Choose Crossfade for clean changes.
Sync timing does not follow the song.
Check the host tempo; Sync uses the host's tempo.
The sound is mono or narrow.
Check STYLE and WIDTH, and whether the STEREO section is bypassed.
Raise GRAIN MIX, and check that the TRANSFORM section is not bypassed.
